prediction.likelyOutcome: Expect partial summary judgment to be granted for SMK against Tres Botes on liability, with most of the $189,200 in stated damages surviving to trial subject to a modest discount for any post-sale rent-stream argument; expect summary judgment to be denied or narrowed on the SDP/Dos Botes claim because of the genuine fact dispute over whether the lease was ever renewed and because SDP's 2013 sale of the property (well before the 2024 breach) raises a real standing/ownership problem with the $324,000 claim that Dos Botes' own (weaker) 'void lease' argument does not even need to reach.

outcome.description: Trial court (judgment signed September 22, 2025) granted summary judgment awarding SMK $79,096.44 against Tres Botes (18 months plus one prorated month at $4,300 until the property was sold) and SDP $108,000 against Dos Botes (12 months at $9,000 until relet), $187,096.44 total; no attorney's fees mentioned. On appeal the $79,096.44 award to SMK was affirmed; the $108,000 award to SDP was reversed and remanded because SDP did not conclusively prove the lease was renewed.
outcome.finalNote: $79,096.44 affirmed; the $108,000 Dos Botes award reversed and remanded, so the final total could rise.
